deviationsFromPlan: Extra first commit (royysusq): the pi-envoy suites were not hermetic to a Legion pane's environment. envoy.test.ts cleared DISPATCH_URL/DISPATCH_TOKEN but not DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE (which the daemon exports into every pane), so 3 Dispatch-tool tests failed here; legion.test.ts inherited the pane's LEGION_TREE/ROLE/ISSUE and 9 tests failed with 'Legion session has both controller and tree launch markers'. Fix: envoy.test.ts beforeEach/afterEach also clear/restore DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE; legion.test.ts gains a beforeEach that deletes every key in its existing environmentKeys list (afterEach already restores them). Both suites pass 75/75 and 49/49 from inside this pane now; the tester's pane will behave the same.

Same commit: three envoy.test.ts sites were already unformatted on main (lines ~1191, ~2398, ~2416 at main); biome check for the package cannot pass without formatting them, so `biome check --write` output for those sites is folded into royysusq rather than a feature commit. envoy.ts's own formatting fix was folded into ynxvrswz (Task 1).

Commits were made with `jj commit -m ... <paths>` (path-scoped) instead of `jj describe && jj new`, to keep the workspace's untracked-by-plan `.omp/config.yml` (an empty file written into the workspace at worker boot, not part of the repo) out of every commit.

legion.test.ts phase-worker test: the plan's `(body as { soft?: boolean }).soft === true` was written as an `in`/`typeof` guard on the unknown body (repo rule ts-no-inline-cast-access); behaviour identical.
